answer: A concrete Sybil defense is triangle-vouched admission: a new identity needs three established sponsors who are not connected to each other, so the vouches cannot come from one cluster. A kernel of clones cannot triangulate itself, because its members all share the same neighborhood; a vine of colluders fails the independence check. A dawn of genuine newcomers finds three separate sponsors over time, and honest agents vouch for people they actually know. The attacker's cost is recruiting three independent established agents per clone, which a closed farm cannot supply.
